_serves_note: Byte route for source images. Declared here because a route the surface fetches but no manifest declares reaches the runtime instead of this provider and 404s — measured twice on other providers before it was understood as a class.
_verbs_note: /api/effects/families is the load-bearing one: it publishes every knob, its range, what it means in plain words, the named looks, and how to disambiguate a vague request. An agent drives the effect from that rather than from our source, which is what makes this agent-drivable rather than merely scriptable. The curve verbs are declared for the same reason as the rest: an undeclared route reaches the SDK runtime instead of this provider and 404s, which has cost this repo three live defects.
_why_this_file_exists: The effect capability belongs to the package that implements it, so an app is a client that names it. That is what lets a timeline app apply a look without owning any of this — and means retiring any single app cannot take the effects with it.
